text: Very thorough read-only first-principles analysis of BK7258 physical mailbox in the project and vendor/original backup. NuttX kernel is forbidden to modify. Model channels, status full bits, source/destination mapping, interrupt routes, send staging registers, FIFO consumption, and AP CPU0/CPU1/CP contention. Determine whether bk7258_smp_kick indefinite waiting on -EAGAIN can deadlock due to target IRQ masking or shared hardware FIFO, especially when called inside scheduler critical sections or ISR. Compare with vendor implementation and old bounded behavior. Return exact references and a minimal board-port fix that preserves NuttX IPI delivery contract without unbounded spinning. Do not edit.
